nvitk.util.colors
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.util.colors

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   ANSI escape-code color constants for terminal output.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.util.colors.bcolors


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: bcolors

   Named ANSI color/style escape codes for use in console print statements.


   .. py:attribute:: HEADER
      :value: '\x1b[95m'



   .. py:attribute:: OKBLUE
      :value: '\x1b[94m'



   .. py:attribute:: OKCYAN
      :value: '\x1b[96m'



   .. py:attribute:: OKGREEN
      :value: '\x1b[92m'



   .. py:attribute:: WARNING
      :value: '\x1b[93m'



   .. py:attribute:: FAIL
      :value: '\x1b[91m'



   .. py:attribute:: ENDC
      :value: '\x1b[0m'



   .. py:attribute:: BOLD
      :value: '\x1b[1m'



   .. py:attribute:: UNDERLINE
      :value: '\x1b[4m'



   .. py:attribute:: WHITE
      :value: '\x1b[37m'



   .. py:attribute:: GRAY
      :value: '\x1b[90m'
